# Your Name: Russian voice over artist

> Native Russian voice over artist based in Sweden (registered sole proprietor, enskild firma). Narrates e-learning, corporate training, instructional videos, documentaries and non-fiction audiobooks in Russian. Delivers WAV 48 kHz / 24-bit from her own studio.

## Main page

- [Home, demos, services and FAQ](https://elana.tolliu.pro/): four Russian-language demos (corporate training, instructional, lecture, educational), what is offered, delivery formats and how to request a quote.
